idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness
idea-plugin.description:
English

DeepSeek Harness embeds the full DeepSeek Harness AI agent workbench directly inside IntelliJ IDEA. Chat with the agent in an embedded web UI, let it read and modify your project files, and review its changes with native diff tooling — a Qoder-like AI coding experience.

Key features

  • Embedded Web UI — the full DeepSeek Harness interface (chat, sessions, goals, workflows) runs in an IDE tool window via JCEF.
  • Workspace-bound agent — the agent works with your current project directory as its workspace (auto-registered on startup); it can read, create and modify project files.
  • IDE context via MCP — the agent can read your current editor selection, open files and project tree, and open/reveal files, through the mcp__ide__* tools.
  • Send selection to DSH — right-click any code selection to send a compact file reference (@path#L1-14) to the harness; the full selection stays available to the agent even if injection fails (clipboard fallback).
  • Review & restore — a baseline snapshot lets you diff agent changes (modified/new/deleted), restore single or all files, ignore, or rebaseline.
  • Self-contained runtime — Node.js and the DeepSeek Harness runtime are bundled with the plugin and extracted on first use; no separate installation or network needed.
  • Multi-project & lifecycle — one instance per project (max 3 concurrent), processes are terminated on project close / IDE exit; crash auto-restart with backoff.
  • Logs & diagnostics — a DSH Log tab shows the dsh process output; crash notifications and a configurable log level help you debug.
  • Bilingual UI — all plugin UI follows your IDE language (English / 简体中文).

Getting started

  1. Open the DeepSeek Harness tool window (right edge) — the bundled runtime is extracted automatically on first open.
  2. Go to Settings → Tools → DeepSeek Harness, enter your DeepSeek API Key (or import it from ~/.dsh), and apply.
  3. Start a conversation; ask the agent to read your code, or select code and use Send Selection to DSH to hand it context.
  4. Use Review changes in the tool window to inspect and restore agent edits.

中文

DeepSeek Harness 把 DeepSeek Harness 智能体工作台完整嵌入 IntelliJ IDEA：在 IDE 内嵌的 Web 界面中与智能体对话，让它读写你的项目文件，并用原生 diff 工具审查它的改动—— 类 Qoder 的 AI 编程体验。

主要功能

  • 内嵌 Web UI — 完整 DeepSeek Harness 界面（对话、会话、目标、工作流）通过 JCEF 在 IDE 工具窗口中运行。
  • 以项目为工作区 — 智能体以当前项目目录为工作区（启动时自动注册）；可读取、 新建、修改项目文件。
  • MCP 桥接 IDE 上下文 — 智能体可通过 mcp__ide__* 工具读取当前 选中代码、打开的文件、项目树，并打开/定位文件。
  • 发送选中代码到 DSH — 右键选中代码即可发送紧凑文件引用 （@路径#L1-14）给智能体；即使注入失败，完整选中代码仍可被智能体获取 （剪贴板兜底）。
  • 审查与还原 — 基线快照让您可以 diff 智能体的改动（修改/新增/删除）， 还原单个或全部文件、忽略、或重新基线。
  • 自包含运行时 — Node.js 与 DeepSeek Harness 运行时随插件打包，首次使用自动 解压；无需单独安装或联网。
  • 多项目与生命周期 — 每项目一个实例（并发上限 3）；项目关闭 / IDE 退出时 自动终止进程；崩溃自动退避重启。
  • 日志与诊断 — DSH Log 标签页显示 dsh 进程输出；崩溃通知与可配置日志级别 便于排查。
  • 中英双语界面 — 插件 UI 跟随 IDE 语言（English / 简体中文）。

快速上手

  1. 打开 DeepSeek Harness 工具窗口（右侧）——首次打开自动解压内置运行时。
  2. 进入 设置 → Tools → DeepSeek Harness，填写 DeepSeek API Key （或从 ~/.dsh 一键导入）并应用。
  3. 开始对话；让智能体阅读你的代码，或选中代码后使用 发送选中代码到 DSH 把上下文交给它。
  4. 在工具窗口使用 审查改动 查看并还原智能体的修改。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
English / 中文

v0.1.3

  • Per-project DSH_HOME: workspace and sessions are now isolated per project, so switching projects no longer mixes up chat history and agent workspaces.
  • 每项目独立 DSH_HOME：工作区与会话按项目隔离，切换项目不再串台（聊天记录、智能体工作区各自独立）。
  • "DSH 一键解释" in the Run console: select a log snippet, right-click and choose it to send the log to the agent for an instant explanation — great for "what went wrong" debugging.
  • 运行控制台新增「DSH 一键解释」：选中日志右键即可一键提交给智能体解释，排查报错更省心。
  • Legacy session migration: after upgrading, previous chat sessions and projection caches are automatically migrated with correct titles — no more missing or mis-titled history.
  • 旧会话升级迁移：升级后自动迁移历史会话与投影缓存，标题正确，历史不再丢失。
  • API key masking & global sync: the API key is now shown masked in Settings and kept in sync across all projects via a single global credential file.
  • API Key 脱敏与全局同步：设置页密钥脱敏回显，所有项目通过全局凭据文件保持同步。
  • Fixed a credential conflict where injecting DEEPSEEK_API_KEY into the runtime environment could make the harness reject the key; the browser is no longer auto-opened on startup (--no-open).
  • 修复凭据冲突：不再向运行时注入 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 环境变量（避免被 dsh 拒绝）； 启动不再自动弹出浏览器（--no-open）。
  • Bundled DeepSeek Harness runtime upgraded to 0.1.1-rc.2; repository source integrity fixed (runtime package sources are now fully tracked in git).
  • 内置 DeepSeek Harness 运行时升级至 0.1.1-rc.2；修复仓库源码完整性（runtime 包源码已全部入库）。

v0.1.2

  • JCEF compatibility on IntelliJ 2026.2: added an (optional) dependency on the bundled "Web Browser (JCEF)" plugin (com.intellij.modules.jcef). Since 2026.2 JCEF is no longer part of the platform core, so plugins using JBCefBrowser must declare this dependency or the classes are not visible at runtime (NoClassDefFoundError).
  • 2026.2 JCEF 兼容修复：新增对内置 "Web Browser (JCEF)" 插件 （com.intellij.modules.jcef）的（可选）依赖。2026.2 起 JCEF 不再属于平台核心， 使用 JBCefBrowser 的插件必须声明该依赖，否则运行时类不可见 （NoClassDefFoundError）。
  • When JCEF still fails to initialize, the tool window now shows the concrete exception plus check hints (enable the JCEF plugin / run the IDE on a JBR with JCEF / restart).
  • JCEF 初始化失败时，工具窗口现在会显示具体异常与排查建议（启用 JCEF 插件 / 以含 JCEF 的 JBR 运行时启动 / 重启）。

v0.1.1

  • Compatibility: now supports IntelliJ IDEA up to 2026.2 (build 262.*). Previously the plugin only declared support up to 2025.1 (build 251.*), so newer IDEs refused to load it.
  • 兼容性：现在支持至 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2（build 262.*）。此前仅声明支持到 2025.1 （build 251.*），新版 IDE 会拒绝加载。
  • Removed dependency on the platform-bundled Gson JSON library (being phased out by JetBrains); JSON serialization is now self-contained and version-independent.
  • 移除对平台自带 Gson JSON 库的依赖（JetBrains 正逐步移除该库）；JSON 序列化改为 自包含实现，与平台版本无关。

v0.1.0

  • Menu icon for "Send Selection to DSH" now matches the plugin icon. 「发送选中代码到 DSH」右键菜单图标与插件图标一致。
  • Distinct icons for the tool window actions: Settings (gear), Open in browser (web), Review changes (diff), Restart (restart).
  • 工具窗口动作区分图标：设置（齿轮）/ 浏览器打开（Web）/ 审查改动（Diff）/ 重启（Restart）。
  • Plugin initialization completed, achieving basic interaction functions.
  • 插件初始化，完成基本交互功能。
